Rationale: The Candidate correctly identifies the target as the person (e2) who performed the discovery. It models the discovery as an entity (e1) and uses a relationship (r1) to link the person to the discovery, filtering the discovery by its ID. This is semantically equivalent to the Ground Truth LISP, which joins an Astronomer with an Astronomical_object. The choice of entity types (Person vs Astronomer) and relationship roles is a valid schema-independent modeling decision.
